title: RTL-Interact: Training EDA-Interactive Models for Multi-Task RTL Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.41225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models offer a promising route to register-transfer-level (RTL) design, but reliable implementations require checking and revision based on electronic design automation (EDA) tools' feedback. Existing RTL-specialized models often lack learned interaction with such EDA tools or rely on separate generation and repair components. We introduce RTL-Interact, a multi-task post-training framework that trains a single RTL-specialized model to generate RTL, construct task-appropriate EDA checks, and revise implementations using tool feedback. The framework combines automatically constructed multi-task demonstrations with staged supervision from chain-of-thought to tool-integrated reasoning. We further introduce Pattern-Aware Policy Optimization (PAPO) for multi-task reinforcement learning. translated_title: RTL-Interact：面向多任务RTL设计的EDA交互式模型训练
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型为寄存器传输级（RTL）设计提供了一条有前景的路径，但可靠的实现需要基于电子设计自动化（EDA）工具的反馈进行检查和修订。现有的RTL专用模型往往缺乏与这类EDA工具的学习式交互，或依赖于相互独立的生成与修复组件。我们提出RTL-Interact，这是一个多任务后训练框架，可将单个RTL专用模型训练为能够生成RTL代码、构建适合任务的EDA检查，并利用工具反馈修订实现。该框架将自动构建的多任务示范与从思维链到工具集成推理的分阶段监督相结合。我们进一步提出了用于多任务强化学习的模式感知策略优化（PAPO）。PAPO在组相对策略优化（GRPO）的基础上增加了以正确性为门控的奖励，倾向于简洁而成功的检查，同时奖励有效的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: RTL-Interact是一个多任务后训练框架，能将单个RTL专用模型训练为同时具备生成RTL代码、构建EDA检查并利用工具反馈修订实现的能力，并提出了模式感知策略优化（PAPO）以提升多任务强化学习效果。
